completeBuy(address,address).details: Anyone may complete a parked buy, but only the payer at a price above the settled one (audit round 2 H-2):      a third party can't complete right after its own push, so it can't sandwich the buy in one transaction; to      buy ahead of it, it must hold the position two blocks, in the open. The payer completes within the drift.

steadyPrice(address).details: The sandwich bound (brief Part 3 item 4, audit round 2 H-2): a fetch buys only at a price within      `MAX_DRIFT_BPS`, up or down, of both the coin's time-weighted mean over the window and its settled price, the      price at the end of the block two before this one (`IRouteCoins.settledPriceOf`), which no trade in this      block or the last can move. So a push in one transaction, one block or two takes the price no further than      the drift from where it stood before them, whatever the mean says; and a fast move either way waits until      the mean has caught up. A coin younger than a window, or one nobody marked a window ago while it traded, has      no mean and waits.

SETTLEMENT().notice: The deployment this fetch is wired to, which Settlement's constructor checks, and the gas its buy gets.

accounted().notice: Every USDC this contract holds for someone: parked buys plus what contributors are owed.

buyFor(address,address,uint256).notice: The swap, the buy and the stake for `payer`, as one call this contract makes to itself, so that any         failure unwinds all three. Reverts `Refused(why)` when the buy should not run now.

completeBuy(address,address).notice: Anyone completes a parked buy for `payer`, ending staked for `payer`; the caller gets nothing.

onLine(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: Settlement has sent `usdc`, the route's share of a claimed line, and calls this. It pays earlier stake         (`ICoinStakes.payHolders`), then swaps the rest to UNB on the pool's steady quote and buys the coin for         `payer`, staked for it. A swap or buy that can't run now parks the USDC for (coin, payer); an entry with         no coin, or a part too small to buy anything, is owed to the credited contributor (`coin.split`). It never         reverts on a pool's or a curve's state; it reverts `LowGas` when the claim can't give the buy its gas.         Only Settlement.

poke(address).notice: Anyone records the coin's time-weighted price anchor, which the fetch's drift bound reads.

referenceOf(address).notice: The coin's time-weighted price over at least `WINDOW` seconds and the price now, or (0, price) when it         has no reference a window old yet. A fetch buys only when the price is within `MAX_DRIFT_BPS` of it, and         of the settled price (`steadyPrice`). The record is the curve's (`IRouteCoins.observe`).

withdraw().notice: A credited contributor takes what `coin.split`'s fallback owes it (pull).
